questions.subject: GEOMETRY
questions.stem: Two triangles have all three sides equal in pairs; which congruence criterion applies?

options.text: SSS congruence applies when all three sides match
SAS congruence applies when all three sides match
AAA congruence applies when all sides match

questions.explanation: SSS congruence holds when all three corresponding sides are equal. SAS needs an included angle. AAA is a similarity criterion, not congruence. Angles are not required for SSS.

questions.stem: What is the key difference between congruence and similarity?
